card.name: Linking words before drug class names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to", "as", "with", "and/or" and the word "drug", just before a drug or comparator name (statins, NSAIDs, placebo). Seen in comparisons and example lists in drug-trial text.

modes.label: Comparison words
modes.description: "compared to" or "with" right before placebo or another treatment arm.
modes.example: nonselective NSAID-treated patients compared<< to>> placebo-treated patients.

modes.label: Listing drug examples
modes.description: "such as", "and/or" or "drug" leading into a named drug or drug class.
modes.example: corticosteroids and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents such<< as>> aspirin and celecoxib

card.writes: It seems to push toward word starts like "stat" (as in statin), but the suppressed tokens are unrelated, so the effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on small words like "to" or "such as" that come right before a named drug or placebo.
